sidebar.title: Sidebar
encouragements: You've done a lot today — take care of yourself.
Your effort matters. Wishing you success ahead.
Small steps still count. Keep going.
Rest when you need to. You've earned it.
One task at a time — you've got this.
Progress isn't always loud. Quiet wins count too.
Your future self will thank you for today's focus.
It's okay to move slowly — just don't stop.
A deep breath is also progress.
You're allowed to celebrate small wins.
Clarity comes one decision at a time.
